topic: Adding a date and time to a Reminders app task so it alerts you at the right moment
headline: Make Reminders Actually Remind You
supporting_text: Add a date and time to a reminder so your phone alerts you right when it matters.
caption:
⚡ TODAY’S 30-SECOND TECH WIN

Ever write a reminder and then forget to check it?

A reminder only helps if it reaches you at the right moment, not just whenever you happen to look.

Open the Reminders app and create a new reminder for something you need to do.

Tap the date and time option and choose when you want to be alerted.

Your phone will gently notify you at that exact moment, so the task doesn't quietly slip away.

Save this tip for later.

Follow @DigitalCalmDaily for one simple 30-Second Tech Win every day.
visual_symbol: a simple bell or clock icon next to a checklist
reel_hook: Get reminded at the right time
reel_steps: Open Reminders and tap New Reminder
Type what you need to remember
Tap the date/time option and set it
